summary: Complete static site redesign for Pousada Betania following DESIGN.md (Refugio Legible). Three-path composition (Hospedar, Reunir, Descansar) replacing Wix anchor-nav. Jost + Public Sans typography, brand colors preserved with --ink-deep evolution. Mobile-first responsive layout fixing 980px overflow on 390px viewport. Real official images from assets/. Omnibees booking and WhatsApp as primary CTAs. All 8 required files produced: index.html, proposal.html, rationale.html, styles.css, script.js, README.md, SITE_REVIEW.md, SOURCE_MANIFEST.md. Evidence-bounded: no invented claims, ratings, room names, or testimonials.
